rootPolicies.test: Explicit CMake references are lexical registration candidates only. vcmitest requires original assets and an isolated TEST profile; feature conditions remain visible. Exporters and managed fixtures are not default-public acceptance.
rootPolicies.client/tests: Registered standalone sources may be pure state checks; other scripts/drivers are manual diagnostics unless an explicit curated runner selects them. GUI probes require the maintained private owner.
rootPolicies.tools/tests: Python checks are conditional on their imports, fixtures and tool dependencies; source presence does not schedule execution. Public CI must choose a reviewed asset-free subset.
rootPolicies.tools/ci: Maintained helpers and explicit diagnostic/delivery entry points, not automatically executed tests. Snapshot/owner tools never gain runtime authority from this inventory.
